## Summary

Describe the change and the user or maintainer problem it solves.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] I changed source templates instead of generated skill files, or this change does not affect skills.
- [ ] I rebuilt generated files when source templates or shared Forge content changed.
- [ ] I added or updated evals for changed behavior.
- [ ] I ran the relevant Forge validators and tests.
- [ ] I updated public documentation and the changelog when behavior changed.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work. It contains no secrets or private source material.
